subject.title: Dashboard: Living Answers + action-form — the chat↔dashboard loop

question: Should maintainers sponsor this stacked dashboard branch after dependency, storage, sandbox, proof, and conflict repairs, or require a narrower replacement PR sequence?
rationale: The unresolved blockers cross dependency/security authorization, persistent state architecture, unauthenticated widget serving, and product direction for a large new dashboard surface; automation can identify repairs but cannot approve those boundary choices.

options.title: Require repair before continuing
options.body: Ask for a refreshed head that removes or authorizes dependency changes, moves state to SQLite/plugin-state, fixes the listed defects, and adds real behavior proof before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Sponsor with explicit exceptions
options.body: A maintainer/security owner could explicitly accept the dependency and storage direction, but conflicts, correctness defects, and proof gaps would still need resolution.

options.title: Pause and replace with narrower PRs
options.body: If the cumulative stack is too broad to review safely, pause this branch and ask for smaller PRs around the Living Answers and action-form delta.

recommendation.title: Require repair before continuing
recommendation.body: Ask for a refreshed head that removes or authorizes dependency changes, moves state to SQLite/plugin-state, fixes the listed defects, and adds real behavior proof before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice spans Control UI plugin surface, dependency/security authorization, and repository storage policy, which are closest to the current-main ownership signals found in this review.
